_comment: Settings for the sign-in gate on /md-viewer and /pdf-editor. This file is PUBLIC — it is served to every visitor — so it holds no credentials of any kind. The username and password live in the Worker's own configuration; see auth-worker/README.md. Edit this file on GitHub to point the pages at a different API; the change is live as soon as Pages rebuilds, with no code change.
_apiBaseUrl: Origin of the deployed authentication Worker. Set this to your own workers.dev subdomain (or a custom domain) after the first deploy — `npx wrangler deploy` prints the URL.
_apiBaseUrlByHost: Per-hostname overrides, matched against location.hostname. Lets the same committed file work against a local `wrangler dev` without editing anything.
_sessionStorageKey: Where the browser keeps its session token. sessionStorage, so it is dropped when the tab closes; it survives refreshes and navigation between the two protected pages in the same tab.
_refreshMinutes: How often an open tab revalidates its session against the Worker, which also slides the inactivity window forward.
